intended_object: A formally étale R-algebra A (Stacks 00UQ): for every R-algebra B and square-zero ideal I ⊆ B, every R-algebra map A → B/I lifts uniquely to A → B. Equivalently, Ω_{A/R} = 0 and H¹ of the (naive) cotangent complex vanishes. Inferred from the name, docstring and Stacks tag.
explanation: The class asks that Ω[A⁄R] and H1Cotangent R A (H¹ of the naive cotangent complex, defined as the kernel of the cotangent complex map for the canonical presentation) both be trivial. Ω = 0 is exactly formal unramifiedness. Formal smoothness amounts to H¹ = 0 together with Ω projective, and Ω = 0 is projective. So the two conditions together say A is formally unramified and formally smooth, which is the same as formally étale. The file proves this equivalence with the infinitesimal lifting definition (`iff_formallyUnramified_and_formallySmooth`, `iff_comp_bijective`). The setting is arbitrary commutative rings and algebras, which is the natural generality. This is Mathlib's own definition, so there is no separate counterpart to cite.
